components.name: Modal
components.description: BEK Modal — a blocking overlay that opens in the centre. Size (S 480 / M 720 / L 900) × Variant (Default / Danger). The surface has no border: layers are separated by shadow and the color/background/neutral/elevated difference.

components.name: Sheet

Description text.default: Slides up from the bottom on mobile.

components.description: BEK Sheet — a blocking overlay that slides up from the bottom on mobile. Drag handle, full-width buttons, radius on the top corners only.

components.name: Scrim
components.description: BEK Scrim — the blocking layer beneath Modal, Sheet and Drawer. Clicking it closes the overlay (except in an Alert dialog).

components.name: Drawer

Description text.default: A short note in the side panel.

components.description: BEK Drawer — a blocking panel that slides in from the edge of the screen. Side (Left / Right) × Size (S 360 / M 480 / L 640). The surface has no border — shadow and the elevated surface colour set it apart. For a panel that opens from the bottom, use Sheet (7.1).

components.name: Popover
components.description: BEK Popover — a lightweight overlay anchored to a trigger element. Size (S 280 / L 360) × Tail (None / Top / Right / Bottom / Left). The surface has no border — shadow/3 and the elevated surface colour set it apart. Tooltip, Dropdown menu and Context menu inherit this surface.

components.name: Menu item
components.description: BEK Menu item — the core item of Dropdown menu and Context menu. Size (S 32 / M 40) × State (Default / Hover / Selected / Disabled) × Variant (Normal / Danger) = 16 variants.

components.name: Menu group label
components.description: BEK Menu group label — the heading for a group of items inside a Dropdown menu.

components.name: Menu separator
components.description: BEK Menu separator — separates groups of menu items. Used only where a group with different content begins.

components.name: Dropdown menu
components.description: BEK Dropdown menu — a list of items that opens when the trigger is clicked. Inherits the Popover surface: radius/7, shadow/3, no border. Width size/menu/w = 240. Items are instances of the Menu item component.

components.name: Context menu
components.description: BEK Context menu — a menu opened by right-click (or long-press on mobile). Uses the same surface and Menu item component as Dropdown menu (7.4); the only differences are the trigger and positioning: it opens from the cursor point.

components.name: Context submenu
components.description: BEK Context submenu — the inner panel that opens from an item with a Submenu arrow. Width size/menu/w-sub = 200; it opens 4 px from the right edge of the parent menu and flips to the left if there isn’t room.

components.name: Alert dialog

Description text.default: Check the details before you confirm.

components.description: BEK Alert dialog — an interrupting dialog that requires a response. Unlike Modal, it has no close button and doesn’t close with Esc or by clicking the scrim — only through a button. Variant (Info / Success / Warning / Danger) × Layout (Inline / Stacked) = 8 variants.

components.name: Command palette
components.description: Keyboard-first launcher opened with ⌘K / Ctrl K. Device = Web (640, centred, footer with key hints) | Mobile (390, full width under the status bar, no key hints) × State = Results | Empty = 4 variants. Built from Menu item (7.4) and Menu group label. Surface background/neutral/elevated, radius/surface/lg, Elevation/4 Overlay, z = layout/z/modal. Motion: motion/overlay/modal/enter · exit.

components.name: Hover card

Description text.default: A short description of the person, page or item behind the link.

components.description: Read-only preview that opens when the pointer rests on a link, name or avatar (open delay 500 ms, close delay 300 ms). Variant = Profile | Link. Width 320, background/neutral/elevated, radius/surface/md, Elevation/3 Floating, z = layout/z/dropdown. No buttons inside — if the user must act, use Popover (7.3). Not available on touch: on mobile, tap goes straight to the target.

components.name: Bottom sheet

Description.default: A short description that explains the content and helps the user decide what to do next.

components.description: Bottom sheet — a panel that slides up over the page for a focused task. Default: title + close + content slot + sticky button. Content: picture, text and CTA (item details, explanations). Promo: full-bleed image, centred headline, primary + “Not now”. surface/raised, top radius 24, handle 36×4. Scrim = bg/overlay. Footer padding includes the home indicator.

components.name: Action sheet
components.description: Action sheet — a short list of actions for the current item, raised from the bottom. Built on the real platform components: iOS 27 action sheet card (Title, message, actions; destructive in text/danger) and Material 3 modal bottom sheet (drag handle, surface) with BEK action rows (icon + label). Painted with BEK tokens; Direction LTR / RTL. Scrim comes from the overlay, not the sheet.

components.name: Share sheet
components.description: Share sheet — preview, people, app targets and a copy-link field for sharing an item. The system draws it in code; this mockup sits on the native iOS 27 sheet surface (grabber, inset rounded sheet) painted with BEK tokens, with BEK content on top. Direction LTR / RTL; Show contacts and Show link field toggle the optional rows.

7.6 Alert dialog.text:
OVERLAYS
BEK
Design System
7.6 Alert dialog
An interrupting dialog that requires a response. Unlike Modal (7.1), it has no close button and doesn’t close with Esc or by clicking the scrim — the user can only leave through a button. Variant (Info / Success / Warning / Danger) × Layout (Inline / Stacked) = 8 variants.
Overview
Three typical cases: a destructive confirmation, a warning, and the stacked layout for mobile.

Anatomy
Three blocks in a fixed order. The missing Close button is deliberate: the user can’t leave without answering the question.

Delete

Icon badge
A 48 × 48 circle with a status/*/soft background and a status/*/default icon. It signals the weight of the message at a glance.
2
Title
18 px Semi Bold. A question or a result — “Delete this?”, “Sent”.
3
Description
14 px Regular, muted. States the consequence: what will be lost, what will change.
4
Actions
Confirm and Cancel. There is never a third button.
5
No Close button
Esc and clicking the scrim don’t work either — the key difference from Modal.
6
Scrim
The Scrim component from 7.1. Clicking it doesn’t close the dialog; the dialog just shakes.
